fusions.name: Spoken Loop
fusions.desc: Throws a strand that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Spell Impetus] for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Recited Knotwork
fusions.desc: Weaves strands round you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Muddled] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on an enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Telling
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Rote Recital
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
